records.statement: For any two orders of n labels, the sharp universal guaranteed nonadjacent-in-both-orders subset size is ceil(n/4).
records.justification: Self-contained lower and sharp upper bound argument archived in sessions/S002/MATHEMATICS.md; academic source establishes overlapping braid-graph subject, not the exact formula.
records.limitations: Human proof only; no Lean formalisation, independent referee or novel status; classical argument.

records.statement: OEIS A343447 concerns alternating 101...101 multiples for every positive integer coprime to 10.
records.limitations: The statement is known, not an S002 discovery.

records.statement: After any two opposite-colour cells are deleted from an even-by-even rectangular board, the rest is domino-tileable.
records.justification: Inspected opposite-colour removal proof and named theorem secondary entry; Hamiltonian cycle gives even paths.
records.limitations: Source primary attribution to Gomory not independently checked.
